name: Blobble
author: M44F4
description: Your Blobble in the bar. A real bar widget: the shell places it, you move it with the rest of the bar's layout, and it follows the bar to any side. Click it for Blobble's panel; right click pokes it; middle click opens the system monitor. Needs the Blobble app (it starts when you first click).

barWidget.description: Your blob. Click it for its mood and settings.
